lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters (approx. 10-15 pixels in diameter) forming vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The nodes are most distinct in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Narrow vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, creating a rectilinear matrix across the visible mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features running horizontally along the upper flank, defined by sharp vertical luminance gradients (light upper edge, shadowed lower edge); the primary ridge extends from the posterior cranial region toward the dorsal fin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 5 to 7 high-luminance blobs are bounded within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, predominantly distributed in the lower and middle regions of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated low-luminance feature is attached to the ventral region, posterior to the pectoral fin's trailing edge, consistent with an external organism.
